edges.text: 150 credits, including 90 credits in biomedicine, pharmaceutical science, chemistry, natural science and/or engineering. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

150 credits, including 120 credits in biomedicine, pharmaceutical science, chemistry, drug discovery, science and/or engineering. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

150 credits of which 120 credits are in biomedicine, pharmaceutical science, and/or natural science. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

note.textSv: Det första året består av obligatoriska kurser med syfte att ge studenten en bred kunskap inom läkemedelsutveckling. För studenter som läst motsvarande kurs i sin grundutbildning finns alternativa kurser.

result.labelEn: The first year consists of mandatory courses providing broad knowledge in drug development, with alternative courses available for students who already covered equivalent material.

note.textSv: Under det andra året väljer studenten kurser.

result.labelEn: During the second year, the student chooses courses.

note.textSv: Valbara fördjupningskurser 15 hp och del av masterprojekt 45 hp eller valbara fördjupningskurser 30 hp.

result.labelEn: Students can either take 15 credits of elective advanced courses plus 45 credits within the master project, or 30 credits of elective advanced courses.

note.textSv: Masterprojekt 30 hp eller del av masterprojekt 45 hp.

result.labelEn: Concerns the master's thesis project of 30 credits or a 45-credit thesis taken in part.
